subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: What should Windows QuickStart do when Anthropic auth selects an Opus API model before the first terminal hatch?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the correct fix depends on maintainer policy for default model cost, explicit paid-credit warnings, and whether to preserve or change Anthropic first-run defaults.

options.title: Warn before hatch
options.body: Keep Anthropic selectable, but require a clear pre-hatch Opus/API billing warning or readiness check plus improved recovery copy before launching the first chat.

options.title: Change first-run default
options.body: Switch the Anthropic QuickStart default to a lower-cost or tester-safe model and require explicit confirmation for Opus during onboarding.

options.title: Document intentional Opus default
options.body: Leave the Opus default as intentional and update onboarding/docs copy so users know Anthropic API credits are required before first chat.

recommendation.title: Warn before hatch
recommendation.body: Keep Anthropic selectable, but require a clear pre-hatch Opus/API billing warning or readiness check plus improved recovery copy before launching the first chat.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Anthropic Opus default and also appears in setup-wizard history, making him the strongest product-routing candidate from the inspected provenance.
